_doc: Complex-pose library for the pose_dsg validator (run.py caption --style pose_dsg). Each pose is decomposed into atomic yes/no propositions (DSG/TIFA-style) so faithfulness is judged atom-by-atom instead of a holistic 1-10 score that over-praises. Levels map to failure modes from the AbHuman/HumanRefiner taxonomy (limb count, hands/fingers, face, pose plausibility). See docs/pose-validation.md. To use one pose's atoms: caption img.png --style pose_dsg --prompt '<pose.prompt>' --atoms <(jq '{atoms: .levels[L].poses[P].atoms}' workflows/poses.json) — or pass the file path of a stripped {atoms:[...]} JSON.
_consumes: pose_dsg --atoms accepts {atoms:[{id,q}]} (object) OR [{id,q}] (bare list). Each pose.atoms below is ready to lift out as that object's value.

levels.name: hands — occlusion, overlap, foreshortening (the most common failure surface)

poses.prompt: a young woman standing, both hands resting on top of her head, elbows pointing outward, front-facing studio photograph

atoms.q: exactly one woman is the main subject
both of her hands are resting on top of her head
her elbows point outward to the sides
each visible hand has at most five fingers and none are fused
she is facing the camera (front view)

poses.prompt: a portrait of a woman with her hands clasped together in front of her chest, fingers interlaced, close-up

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
both her hands are clasped together in front of her chest
the fingers are visibly interlaced (not merged into a single mass)
there are exactly two hands and two arms visible
no fingers are fused, missing, or extra

poses.prompt: a woman holding her open right palm toward the camera in a stop gesture, foreshortened hand close to the lens

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
her right palm faces the camera in a stop gesture
the visible hand has exactly five fingers
the hand appears larger due to foreshortening (closer to camera)

levels.name: limb position & viewpoint — 3D spatial relations, partial occlusion

poses.prompt: a woman sitting cross-legged on the floor, seen from a 3/4 angle, knees toward the camera

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
she is sitting cross-legged
the camera angle is a 3/4 (three-quarter) view, not straight-on
her knees point toward the camera
there are exactly two legs and two arms (no extras from occlusion)

poses.prompt: a woman looking over her shoulder, body turned away in 3/4 profile, head turned toward the viewer

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
her body is turned away from the camera (3/4 profile)
her head is turned to look back over her shoulder at the viewer
the neck twist looks within a plausible human range of motion
her face is visible and not distorted

poses.prompt: a woman captured mid-jump, one knee tucked up toward her chest, arms spread, dynamic action

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
she is airborne (mid-jump)
one knee is tucked up toward her chest
her arms are spread outward
the pose is physically plausible (no broken joints)

levels.name: full-body complex structure — multi-joint + occlusion + face

poses.prompt: a woman in a dancer's pose (nataraja), standing on one leg, the other leg lifted behind, one arm reaching back to hold the raised ankle

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
she stands on one leg
her other leg is lifted behind her
one of her arms reaches back toward the raised ankle
all four limbs are accounted for (two arms, two legs, none duplicated)
the joints are within a plausible human range of motion

poses.prompt: a woman seen from the back, twisting her torso to face the viewer, hands on hips

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
her back is toward the camera
her torso is twisted to face the viewer
both her hands rest on her hips
the torso twist looks plausible (not a broken spine)

poses.prompt: a woman reclining on her side on a couch, propped up on one elbow, head supported by her hand

atoms.q: exactly one woman is shown
she is reclining on her side
she is propped up on one elbow
her head is supported by her hand
exactly two arms and two legs are present

levels.name: multi-subject / interaction — limb-handoff boundaries (fused/extra limbs most likely here)

poses.prompt: two women standing back-to-back, both looking at the camera over their outer shoulders

atoms.q: exactly two women are shown
they stand back-to-back
each has her own two arms and two legs (no shared/fused limbs)
both look at the camera over their outer shoulders

poses.prompt: two women holding hands facing the camera, side by side

atoms.q: exactly two women are shown
they stand side by side facing the camera
they are holding each other's hand
the total hand count is four and none are fused
the total arm count is four
